headline: AUM fall at North Georgia, leaving three sides unbeaten
dek: Trevecca and UAH have won all six of their matches, and Lee have drawn two of four without losing. AUM's defeat at North Georgia was their first of the season. Delta State scored three times against Eckerd, having managed one goal in their first four matches.
displaced_by: AUM lost at North Georgia, so 'four unbeaten sides win eleven of thirteen' no longer holds; three sides remain unbeaten and Delta State scored three in one match.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The scoring at the top is not one striker's doing: UAH's ten goals have come from seven different players.

wire.line: Union's win at Christian Brothers is the first between two members this season, and Union's first win of any kind.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches have passed their date with no result at all, the earliest Trevecca's at Belmont.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Daniel Santema has kept three clean sheets for Delta State and has conceded three goals all season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Christian Brothers have lost three of their four matches and conceded ten goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lee are unbeaten, with two wins and two draws, and have conceded two goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Harry McLean, a freshman, has scored four goals for Mississippi Christian from seven shots.

last_match.line: Delta State had not scored more than once in any match before this; Daniel Santema keeps another clean sheet.

next_match.line: Spring Hill have yet to win; Tuskegee have already won at Union.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
